issues.message: Notification preferences mentioned in acceptance criteria but no dedicated settings screen designed
Group invite functionality mentioned but detailed workflow not fully specified in screens

recommendations: Consider adding a dedicated Settings screen for notification preferences and account management
Add more detailed specification for group invitation workflow (email invites vs in-app search)
Consider implementing real-time updates for group discussions using WebSockets
Add analytics tracking to measure feature usage and user engagement
Consider implementing a reputation/points system to incentivize quality note sharing
Plan for content moderation tools to handle inappropriate content
Consider adding export functionality for notes and group discussions
Implement rate limiting on API endpoints to prevent abuse
Add comprehensive logging for security auditing
Consider implementing two-factor authentication for enhanced security
